verdict.rationale: DeepSeek's changelog announces multimodal input on the API: an experimental vision model (DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp) and V4.1 Flash with "native multimodal support". A community report says the model can now be used with multimodal support, superseding an earlier complaint that v4 was not multimodal. The evidence is limited to update announcements, with no input guide or scoping of which modalities are accepted, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: documented request format for image input, audio or document input support, a clear modality-scoping statement, and hands-on corroboration of image calls.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send images, audio, or documents to the model — or the docs honestly scope the model to text-only input

citations.quote: the new multimodal vision understanding model DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp is now available on the DeepSeek API platform
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is now available on the DeepSeek API with native multimodal support.
A very powerful model, and with multimodal support now, it can be used as a primary model.
